mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat from absorption through chylomicron packaging into lymph made its different route from glucose and amino acids concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The glucose and amino-acid absorption pictures were nearly identical and did not explain how either crosses the intestinal cell.

surprise.text: Fat packaging was a separate villus operation after absorption, and the resulting chylomicrons entered lymph before reaching blood.

arbitrary.text: Combining the absorbed fat directly with packaging materials and chylomicrons directly with the lacteal entrance seemed physically plausible, but both required the villus as the partner. Compatibility feedback resolved each attempt automatically.

continue.text: I would continue: comparing the blood and lymph routes was useful, and I would be interested to see how the nutrients are handled after reaching circulation and the liver.
